configurations.name: api
runtimeArgs: STREAM_PROVIDER= POLYGON_NIGHTLY_ENABLED=false SCHWAB_NIGHTLY_ENABLED=false FUTURES_NIGHTLY_ENABLED=false FUTURES_POLYGON_NIGHTLY_ENABLED=false OPTIONS_SNAPSHOT_ENABLED=false poetry run uvicorn app.main_api:app --reload --port 8001
configurations.comment: Read-only preview API. Stream and ALL writers are OFF so this instance never competes with the primary server. OPTIONS_SNAPSHOT_ENABLED=false specifically matters: the primary on :8000 owns the options snapshot loop, and two writers racing the same ClickHouse table would have the last write win by snapshot_ts regardless of which one has the correct parser.

configurations.name: cockpit
configurations.comment: 5174, not vite's default 5173: this repo is worked in several git worktrees at once and 5173 is usually already taken by another one. strictPort makes a clash fail loudly instead of silently landing on a port nothing is pointed at.
